purpose: Bounded review of a brief-only proposed system design; not production certification.

scale.1: Named only; substantial omissions prevent implementation or credible validation.
scale.2: Useful partial design; at least one material ambiguity or missing condition remains.
scale.3: Implementation-ready within explicitly bounded assumptions; every required element is concrete and traceable, with only minor non-blocking limitations.
scale.4: Comprehensive and precise: boundary and negative cases, alternatives, recovery and objective evidence are explicit; implementation and verification require no material design invention.

dimensions.name: Scope and task completeness
checks: Business decision, actor, start/end conditions, non-goals and success outputs are explicit.
Task outcomes partition the stated work without overlaps or example-as-task inflation; sequence versus choice is coherent.
Missing input, unsupported request, human disposition, cancellation and terminal outcomes exist where relevant.

dimensions.name: Traceability and provenance
checks: Every included leaf reaches components, workflow and verification; every component is used or justified.
All referenced IDs exist and refer to the intended responsibility; failure-mode-to-eval links are reciprocal and semantically correct.
Context facts, hypotheses and exact upload passages are distinguished; thresholds and vendor claims carry honest evidence boundaries.
Current canonical scope and stable IDs are consistent across dependent revisions.

dimensions.name: Workflow state and recovery
checks: Reachable entry and explicit terminal states exist.
Every edge has a predicate, exclusivity/precedence or fan-out/join meaning; loops have bounded exits.
State transitions, timeout, retries, human queues, cancellation and uncertain external commit outcomes are defined.
Concurrency, version checks, idempotency and read-after-write reconciliation prevent duplicated or stale actions.

dimensions.name: Component and tool contracts
checks: Every agent has bounded judgement responsibility and a typed input/output contract including evidence and abstention.
Every read/write API names target resource, identifiers, validation, response/error shapes and record proof.
Human triggers define queue, owner, SLA, acknowledgement and escalation.
No coding agent must invent a material API or payload field to implement an approved design.

dimensions.name: Authority, privacy and deterministic controls
checks: Money, dates, policy, caps and permissions are enforced by code; LLM output has no authority to grant writes.
Every side effect has a named actor/policy approval, least-privilege scope and fresh API enforcement bound to the intended resource/version/action.
Tenant/subject isolation, untrusted inputs, sensitive-data minimisation, audit and retention boundaries are explicit.
Completion requires durable record IDs; policy/version staleness and authorization revocation fail safely.

dimensions.name: Uncertainty and context quality
checks: No invented operational volumes, policy thresholds, regulatory interpretation or live vendor facts presented as established.
Missing facts are explicit hypotheses/questions with safe defaults or launch blockers.
Conflicting evidence, insufficient evidence and ambiguous intent lead to clarification/abstention/human routing.
Synthetic test facts and illustrative budgets/prices are clearly labelled.

dimensions.name: Architecture and vendor decision
checks: Architecture choice follows workflow state/durability/approval needs and includes a rejected alternative.
Relevant orchestration options use identical criteria; simple deterministic systems may need no framework.
Tools/permissions and data categories compare AWS/GCP/Azure/open-source alternatives fairly.
Tradeoffs, constraints, operational ownership and evidence boundaries support a defensible selection.

dimensions.name: Model allocation and cost realism
checks: Exactly one plan exists for every LLM judgement component with bounded role, tier rationale and rejected tier.
Calls, input/output tokens and prices are explicitly illustrative or measured; arithmetic and units are reproducible.
Retries, long context, escalation/fallback, peak latency and evaluation assumptions are addressed.
Fine-tuning requires labelled failure evidence and held-out improvement criteria.

dimensions.name: Case-specific risk analysis
checks: Failures name concrete cause, effect and affected tasks/components for this use case.
Wrong subject, stale policy/data, duplicate/concurrent write, prompt injection, tool timeout/uncertain commit, false completion and human queue failure are covered where relevant.
Severity/occurrence/detection scoring has a clear scale and honest uncertainty; high-severity action ownership is explicit.
Every unaccepted risk has a specific preventive/detective control, KPI and linked test that actually exercises it.

dimensions.name: Executable evaluation and coverage
checks: Golden cases contain concrete fixtures, inputs, exact expected records/actions and mechanically checkable pass rules.
Each unaccepted failure and high-risk leaf has a substantive test; IDs alone do not count as semantic coverage.
Boundary, negative, adversarial, concurrency, timeout/retry and recovery tests are included.
Component and end-to-end test sets, labelling, representative strata, online monitor, cadence, release gates and stop conditions are concrete.

dimensions.name: KPI causality and rollout governance
checks: Business KPIs have definitions, denominator/window and honest baseline/target status; AI metrics have an explicit causal mechanism and guardrail.
Shadow, assist, pilot and scale have accountable owners, objective gates, minimum evidence and rollback/stop actions.
Experiment specifies randomisation unit, baseline, stratification/contamination control, duration and sample-size method rather than unsupported sample numbers.
Safety events cannot be masked by average quality gains; owner accepts residual risk explicitly.

dimensions.name: Export implementability and coherence
checks: Build instructions and acceptance criteria cover data/state model, APIs, controls, monitoring, tests and rollout without introducing new scope.
Architecture, handoff, eval and FMEA artifacts agree with the canonical design and preserve IDs.
A competent implementer can identify missing external contracts and launch blockers without inventing design decisions.
No claim that a reviewed design, synthetic case or heuristic score proves production correctness.

severity.critical: Design permits unauthorized/wrong-subject/duplicate irreversible action, fabricates successful completion, or bypasses deterministic authority; production-safety blocker.
severity.major: Material completeness, implementability, traceability or evaluation gap; prevents passing the affected dimension at 3.
severity.minor: Useful precision or evidence improvement that does not require a material implementation decision.

method: Inspect canonical design and brief against D1-D12, citing IDs and evidence. Repair and re-review for at most three revision rounds. Label independent-agent only for a different evaluator, otherwise self-review. Never lower thresholds.
limitations: Scores are AI judgement, not measured accuracy, compliance or production evidence.
Designs cannot establish actual API support, policy legality, savings or live provider reliability.
Structural checks verify format and references; golden assertions remain specifications until the business harness executes them.
